items.title: Google's patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment's future
items.excerpt: Google filed a patent for 'My Channel', a system that would use a viewer's demographic data and viewing history to write its own prompts and generate personalized AI videos and ads in an endless feed. The patent has been rejected for now, but Google could appeal or resubmit.

items.title: David Fincher Explains AI Use in 'Cliff Booth' and How AI Can Be Used on Film Sets to Reduce the Amount of Takes
items.excerpt: In an interview published Wednesday, Fincher confirmed some AI was used in post-production on 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth' and described using AI on set to cut the number of takes while keeping performances by 'real human beings'. (Fincher opinion angle covered 11-22; only take if shot-level detail is new.)

items.title: David Fincher Details His Vision for AI Filmmaking That Is Still 'Based on Real Human Beings'
items.excerpt: TheWrap's account of the same Fincher interview, laying out how he sees AI fitting into the filmmaking process on 'Cliff Booth', which arrives on Netflix over Thanksgiving. Same story as the Variety item; keep only one.

items.title: David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
items.excerpt: Viewers say 'Cliff Booth' is full of AI artifacts; The Verge looks at the interpositive/AI-processing questions behind the backlash before Fincher's own explanation. Part of the Fincher cluster.

items.title: AI Horror Short 'Sikkal' Wins WIF India x Google Flow Filmathon
items.excerpt: Promita Banerjee's AI horror short 'Sikkal', about sickle cell disease in India's tribal communities, won the first WIF India x Google Flow Filmathon at IFFI Goa; the director says she aims to make 'films with humans'. This is the winner announcement; the Filmathon itself was covered 11-25.

items.title: Generative AI Indian Feature 'Maharaja in Denims' Sets April 2027 Release
items.excerpt: Khushwant Singh's novel about a young man reliving the life of Sikh ruler Maharaja Ranjit Singh is nearing completion as a $500,000-plus generative AI feature. The makers say they effectively had to make it three times, and are aiming for an April 2027 release.

items.title: Lionsgate Play Sets 'Eklavya' As First AI-Led Series
items.excerpt: Lionsgate Play's first AI-led original series, 'Eklavya', is based on the Mahabharata archer and stars Yug R.Ai, the AI actor character recently unveiled by CEO Rohit Jain. It will roll out on Tiger TV, and Variety reports a Google Cloud partnership.

items.title: 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' producer to appeal Academy eligibility ruling
items.excerpt: The producer of Zack London (Gossip Goblin)'s AI-rendered sci-fi animation says he will appeal the Academy's ruling that the film does not meet the animated-feature definition, under which movement must be created frame by frame. This is a stated intent to appeal, not yet a filed one.

items.title: Josh D'Amaro Is Dragging Disney Into the AI Era, Kicking and Screaming
items.excerpt: New CTO Karandeep Anand is pushing one AI vision across Disney's business units, which is causing tension. Machine learning is already speeding up pre- and post-production, including a Disney Research/ILM tool that cuts render compute by nearly a third. People inside question whether one AI workflow can fit both Marvel blockbusters and 2D animation.

items.title: EBS, 생성형 AI 기반 애니메이션 5편 내달 순차 방영
items.excerpt: EBS picked 5 of 429 entries in its 2026 generative-AI animation co-production project. The shows mix generative AI with stop-motion and 3D, and from Dec. 1 they air on EBS 1TV in a dedicated AI-animation slot, Tue-Thu 5:20-5:50 p.m.

items.title: 모픽AI, 겹치는 대사까지 동시 처리하는 AI 더빙 툴 출시…90개 이상 언어 지원
items.excerpt: Morphic released Morphic Dub, a dubbing tool for film, drama and animation distribution. It handles overlapping dialogue between multiple characters, supports 90+ languages, keeps the original actor's timbre with lip-sync, and leaves the music and effects tracks untouched.

items.title: 일레븐랩스, 국내 AI 단편제작 프로젝트 '더 콜라보레이션 2026'에 기술 파트너로 참여
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs is the technology partner for 'The Collaboration 2026', which pairs seven Korean film directors with AI artists on AI short films (including the Seoul Independent Film Festival short 'The Signal'). The films screen at CGV Apgujeong on Nov. 27. Off-list outlet: the on-list Korean feeds did not carry this story.

items.title: KOBIS 일별 박스오피스: AI 장편 '라파엘' 개봉일(11/25) 관객 539명, 51개 스크린
items.excerpt: KOBIS daily box office for Nov. 25: 'Raphael', MBC C&I/Matteo AI Studio's 100% AI feature, ranked 26th on opening day with 539 admissions (1,395 cumulative including previews), KRW 3.49M in sales, 51 screens and 68 showings. These are first-day numbers; no outlet article yet, so the date is the KOBIS data release.

items.title: LEARN HYBRID AI FILMMAKING (Curious Refuge x Dave Clark / Promise)
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge and director Dave Clark's studio Promise announce a Hybrid AI Filmmaking course: shoot real actors on a simple set, then build the world around them with AI. The waitlist opens Nov. 25 and training starts Jan. 13, 2027.

items.title: The Chroma Awards Are Back as ElevenLabs' Flagship Competition for AI Creators is Live
items.excerpt: Season 2 of ElevenLabs' Chroma Awards is taking entries of AI-made film, music videos, ads, games and BTS content until Jan. 7, 2027, with $450,000+ in cash and travel prizes. This is a competition call, an angle already saturated.

items.title: Sand.ai Launches Full MAGI-2 Video Model, With Open Weights Still Promised
items.excerpt: Sand.ai released the full MAGI-2 audio-video generation model, with 480B total parameters (4x the Preview), longer generation and one-take 30-second shots. Open weights are still promised. Off-list outlet: no on-list source covered this model release.
